mapper.select: SELECT CAST(e.event_id AS VARCHAR) AS event_id, e.event_type, e.decision_st, e.event_at, l.location_nm AS location_name, l.location_type, (a.action_id IS NOT NULL) AS handled FROM tb_detection_event e JOIN tb_location l ON l.location_id = e.location_id JOIN tb_ward w ON w.ward_id = l.ward_id LEFT JOIN tb_event_action a ON a.event_id = e.event_id WHERE w.hosp_div_id = #{hospitalId} AND w.ward_id = #{wardId} AND ( e.event_at >= (DATE_TRUNC('day', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') OR (a.action_id IS NULL AND e.event_type = 'FALL' AND e.decision_st = 'CONFIRMED' AND e.event_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') ) AND (e.event_detail ->> 'duplicate_of') IS NULL ORDER BY e.event_at

SELECT w.hosp_div_id AS hospital_id, w.ward_id FROM tb_detection_event e JOIN tb_location l ON l.location_id = e.location_id JOIN tb_ward w ON w.ward_id = l.ward_id WHERE e.event_id = CAST(#{eventId} AS UUID)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_event_action ( event_id, handler_id, patient_nm, action_content ) VALUES ( CAST(#{eventId} AS UUID), #{handlerId}, #{patientName}, #{actionContent} ) ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING
